## What this changes

A sentence or two. Link the issue if there is one.

## How I tested it

- [ ] `pnpm test` and `pnpm check` pass
- [ ] I tried it in the browser (editor, site, or both)

## Adding a logo?

- [ ] The SVG comes from the brand's official press kit or site, is a plain vector and is under 20 kB
- [ ] It's listed in `src/data/svgs.ts` with a title, category and website
- [ ] Light and dark versions if the brand has them (`-light` / `-dark` suffix)
- [ ] I ran `pnpm build:cuts -- --only <file>.svg` so the sticker gets its cut line
